article_title: Selena Gomez pushes back against 'frivolous' fraud claims

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Selena Gomez's attempt to be dismissed from an investors' fraud case involving the mental-health company Wondermind
Selena Gomez announcing that she will stop acting and become a full-time lawyer
Investors buying nearly $1.2m of perfume directly from Gomez's fans
The cancellation of the next series of Only Murders in the Building
tasks.correct_answer: Selena Gomez's attempt to be dismissed from an investors' fraud case involving the mental-health company Wondermind
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בטענות המשקיעים נגד Wondermind ובבקשתה של סלינה גומז להוציא אותה מן התביעה.

tasks.prompt: What role do the investors say Gomez was expected to perform at Wondermind?
options: She was expected to work as the company's medical director
She was expected to help build the company as its head of marketing
She was expected to represent the five investors in court
She was expected to write every article on the platform herself
tasks.correct_answer: She was expected to help build the company as its head of marketing
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המשקיעים טוענים שנאמר להם כי גומז תהיה מעורבת בבניית החברה ותשמש כראש השיווק.

tasks.prompt: How does Gomez's lawyer respond to the claim that she managed the company?
options: He says she managed it only after the investment was lost
He says she accepted every commitment described by the investors
He says she never agreed to manage the company or make those commitments
He says she sold the company before it was founded
tasks.correct_answer: He says she never agreed to manage the company or make those commitments
tasks.explanation_hebrew: עורך דינה טוען שגומז לא הסכימה לנהל את החברה ולא התחייבה לתפקיד שמתארים המשקיעים.

tasks.prompt: Why might Gomez's strong legal response leave her mother in a more difficult position?
options: Her mother has been appointed as the judge in the case
Her mother has agreed to repay the investment immediately
Her mother is no longer connected to Wondermind in any way
Her mother remains among those facing the fraud allegations if Gomez is removed from the case
tasks.correct_answer: Her mother remains among those facing the fraud allegations if Gomez is removed from the case
tasks.explanation_hebrew: אם גומז תוצא מן התביעה, אמה עדיין נשארת בין הנתבעים לצד החברה ומייסד נוסף.

tasks.prompt: What does “threadbare” mean when Gomez's lawyer describes the claims that way?
options: Supported by detailed and consistent evidence
Weak and lacking enough convincing detail
Written only for social-media fans
Connected to the clothing industry
tasks.correct_answer: Weak and lacking enough convincing detail
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר המשפטי threadbare מתאר טענות דלות וחלשות שאין בהן פירוט משכנע מספיק.

tasks.prompt: What does “guardrails” mean in the advice about family businesses?
options: Barriers placed around a film set
Rules for protecting a celebrity's social-media password
Clear safeguards, roles and procedures that reduce business risk
Advertisements designed to attract new investors
tasks.correct_answer: Clear safeguards, roles and procedures that reduce business risk
tasks.explanation_hebrew: guardrails משמש כאן כמטפורה לכללים, גבולות ומנגנוני פיקוח שמונעים בעיות בעסק משפחתי.

tasks.prompt: State two claims made by the investors and two points made in Gomez's defence.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בבירור בין טענות המשקיעים לבין תגובת עורך דינה של גומז.
expected_points: The investors say they put nearly $1.2m into Wondermind
They allege Gomez breached her contract by not properly supporting the platform
They say they were told she would actively build the company as head of marketing
Gomez's lawyer calls the allegations vague, generalised and contradictory
Her lawyer says she never agreed to manage the company
Her lawyer denies that she made the commitments described by the investors
Her lawyer has asked for her dismissal from the case

tasks.prompt: Why does the PR expert think doing business with close relatives needs more structure, not less?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד אמון ויחסים אישיים עלולים לטשטש אחריות, פיקוח וסיכון למוניטין.
expected_points: Personal and business boundaries can become difficult to separate
Natural family trust may cause people to apply fewer normal commercial rules
A celebrity's reputation can become tied to the company's conduct
Responsibilities should be defined in advance
Independent oversight can reduce conflicts and blind spots
The business should decide beforehand what happens if something goes wrong
A family relationship should not replace formal governance

tasks.prompt: Summarise the dispute, Gomez's response and the wider lesson about celebrity family businesses.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את החברה וההשקעה, את הטענה המרכזית, את תגובת גומז ולפחות לקח עסקי אחד.
expected_points: Five investors allege they lost nearly $1.2m after investing in Wondermind
They say Gomez did not provide the backing or marketing role they expected
Gomez's lawyer denies that she agreed to manage the company or made those commitments
Her lawyer is seeking to have her dismissed from the case
The case may place pressure on her mother and the other defendants
Family businesses need clearly defined roles and independent oversight
Celebrities should consider how a company could affect their reputation

tasks.prompt: Write brief advice to a celebrity considering starting a company with a family member. Use evidence from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח עצה מעשית באנגלית ולהסתמך על לפחות שלושה לקחים קונקרטיים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Define each person's responsibilities in writing
Use formal contracts rather than relying only on family trust
Bring in independent oversight
Agree in advance how disputes or failures will be handled
Keep personal relationships separate from corporate governance
Be precise about what the celebrity will do for investors and the company
Assess how the company could affect the celebrity's reputation
